lastCompletedStory.title: Stop closing the issue in ship-finalize; stash the resolved issueId instead

nextStoryContext: US-004 refactored finalizeCycleClose in src/commands/ship-finalize.ts: removed readIssues/writeIssues seams (no more issue file writes at finalize time), added stashFn injectable that calls stashIssueIdInMergeWatch before the prd.json git rm. PrdShape.issueNumber widened to number|string (CAM-113 root: /cam-next writes full string id). resolveIssueId (US-001) resolves both forms; unresolvable but non-null issueNumber throws. FinalizeCycleCloseResult.issueLocalClosed removed; issueId is now string|null. index.ts _buildFinalizeOpts updated: removed readIssues/writeIssues, added stashFn wiring via stashIssueIdInMergeWatch+MERGE_WATCH_FILENAME from merge-watch.ts. Integration test updated: dirty-prd test now uses stashFn seam; missing-files variant now expects noOp (no issue-file staging = nothing to commit). Tests: 2749 pass, 0 fail. check:all green. The full post-merge close flow is now: finalize stashes issueId -> branch merges -> closeIssueOnMain (US-003) closes the issue on main. US-005 and beyond wire closeIssueOnMain into runPostMerge.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Story wires internal primitives only (resolveIssueId from US-001, stashIssueIdInMergeWatch from US-002, node:child_process spawnSync abstraction). No external library exercised.
